## [FX-IT61-80C] Section 80C — Deduction for investments (up to FY 2025-26)
section: 80C
effective_from: 2023-04-01
effective_to: 2026-03-31
topic: deductions
verified: yes

Under section 80C of the Income-tax Act, 1961, an individual in the old regime can deduct up to 1,50,000 rupees a year for investments such as PPF, ELSS, life insurance premium and EPF. This applies up to FY 2025-26. The deduction is not available in the new regime under section 115BAC.

## [FX-IT61-115BAC-2024] Section 115BAC — New regime slabs for FY 2024-25
section: 115BAC
effective_from: 2024-04-01
effective_to: 2025-03-31
topic: slabs
verified: yes

For FY 2024-25 the new regime under section 115BAC of the Income-tax Act, 1961 had these slabs: up to 3 lakh nil, 3 to 7 lakh 5 percent, 7 to 10 lakh 10 percent, 10 to 12 lakh 15 percent, 12 to 15 lakh 20 percent and above 15 lakh 30 percent. The rebate under section 87A was up to 25,000 rupees for income up to 7 lakh.
